profile.headline: Consulting Embedded Software Engineer at ComNet
profile.summary:
I enjoy using my extensive knowledge of and over twenty years of experience working with embedded microprocessor systems to lead, inspire and cooperate with teams of electrical engineers and embedded software developers to create robust embedded solutions quickly and efficiently.

I also enjoy keeping up with the latest PC hardware, software, & network technology, helping end users to solve PC problems and keep their systems running smoothly.

Specialties: Embedded C, C++, Assembly language, PowerPC, 80x86, 8051, 68HC11/HC16 and Microchip PIC processors. Emulators, debuggers, logic analyzers, serial analyzers and oscilloscopes. Distributed architectures, serial communications, custom FPGA peripherals, boot loaders, flash memory, IR remote controls, audio and video.

DIRECT CONSULTING (1099) or REMOTE CONTRACT inquiries ONLY, no relocation or on-site positions, please.

positions.title: Consulting Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-remote development and integration of custom embedded operating system solutions for industrial Ethernet, Video, Data, Audio and Access Control products, reporting directly to the VP, Engineering.

positions.title: Embedded Systems, Software and IT Consultant
positions.description:
Embedded IoT product development and Embedded Linux/Linux software development, in C, C++, and Python, and embedded systems & software design services.

General IT and PC consulting services including procurement, installation, upgrades, maintenance and repair of PC, laptop and networking hardware and software. Experienced with the installation/configuration/deployment of cloud servers, VPNs, DSL and cable broadband service, SOHO networks, multi-boot systems, virtual machines, HTML/CSS, Apache web and FTP servers, WordPress, Linux, SNMP, VOIP, remote access and similar technologies.

positions.title: Embedded Linux Consultant
positions.description: Custom Linux device driver development to specification for a 64-bit RISC-V SOC running Fedora Linux, simulated and tested on FPGAs, software simulation platforms like Verilator, and emulators such as QEMU.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Consultant
positions.description: Rework fail-safe boot loader code for a widely-deployed RFID card "reader" device, to work with a new SPI FLASH memory device required to replace an obsolete part.

positions.title: Lead Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Firmware development and maintenance for high capacity, high reliability Video-Over-IP transport systems, carrying critical live television broadcasts (including the Olympic Games) over optical fiber and copper media. The devices perform video compression and format conversion in a hardware data plane, using FPGAs on modular circuit cards. A software control plane, implemented by two Freescale PowerPC 603 processors in a dual redundant, hot backup configuration, monitors and manages the hardware. 

Designed a custom command line interpreter (CLI) or “shell” framework for embedded Linux in C and C++, to control next-generation media transport systems.

Built a utility in Python to translate Japanese language comments in C and C++ source to English. Taught system test engineers to create a 1 GBPS “packet storm” of VLAN traffic, using the open source Ostinato packet generator. Configured and administered local and cloud based Linux servers, including a RMS (Requirements Management System) database server, to support globally distributed requirements capture, review and approval by teams in Japan, Australia and Germany.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rapid, agile development of object oriented embedded and PC software written in C, C#, "Windows Power Shell” and assembly language for a secure, networked, stored value contactless (RFID) smart card payment and identification system, incorporating web servers, web services, advanced encryption algorithms, on-site network appliances and Bluetooth equipped contactless smart card readers based on PIC24F 16 bit micro controllers.

Designed and implemented a fail-safe embedded boot loader and FLASH update protocol for the PIC based readers, along with a PC application in Microsoft C# capable of updating them remotely, during normal operation, via Bluetooth radio link.

Independently developed a lightweight internationalization (i18n) platform, along with a suite of embedded card reader applications written in GNU “C”, including a universal electromechanical washer/dryer controller, MDB master and slave controllers, and a desktop attendant value station with bit mapped user interface and keypad.

Selected, evaluated and deployed a Zero Configuration VPN solution linking over fifty host “network appliance” computers on four continents, including highly secure PCI PA-DSS certified credit payment terminals.

Selected, evaluated and deployed Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) solutions for reverse engineering undocumented source code, remote PC access, Ethernet/IP protocol analysis, web proxies, OS image partitioning/production, Bluetooth performance evaluation and Linux servers (Ubuntu).

Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio, Microchip MPLAB, Keil and OpenWatcom IDEs.

Wrote software design documents, user's manuals and installation instructions.

Employed bus protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes and other test instruments to troubleshoot micro controller hardware and communication links in electrically noisy environments.

Performed limited travel overseas and within the contiguous U.S., for system deployment and customer support purposes.

positions.title: Senior software engineer/tech lead
positions.description:
Developed commercial and military real-time avionics software for advanced 32 bit MPC555/5554 PowerPC processors, under FAA DO-178 guidelines for safety critical systems.

Technical lead role in the design of a PowerPC based operating system for a Full Authority Digital Engine Control unit (FADEC) backup channel, used to control Rolls-Royce turbo shaft jet engines on Bell 407 helicopters. Avoided costly FAA re-qualification of an existing verification tool by designing a system to convert the PowerPC compiler's DWARF debug symbols to the primary channel's legacy 80x86 format. 

Customized the Vector XCP engine calibration protocol for the Green Hills Integrity/MPC745 platform. 

Successfully completed the FAA qualification process for an in-house software verification tool. Wrote build scripts, performed release builds, authored comprehensive design documents for software components and systems, and maintained design and test traceability information using Telelogic DOORS software.

positions.title: Senior software engineer
positions.description:
Ongoing team oriented development and maintenance of real time industrial process controller operating systems written in “C” and “C++”, running on custom designed Pentium-class hardware.

Employed object oriented design techniques to deliver high reliability solutions within a large (100 KLOC) framework running under the MTOS-UX RTOS.

Created software, software test plans and test programs written in IEC 61131 process control language, including converting the company's existing AGA3 gas orifice meter calculation module to an equivalent IEC 61131 function block.

Advocated for and received approval to update the company's firmware build process. The re-implemented system was capable of automatically and correctly calculating dependencies for the entire 100 KLOC code base in seconds.

positions.title: Software design engineer
positions.description:
Performed independent and collaborative design of embedded software written in “C” and assembly language for high-end consumer electronics products.

Independently designed and implemented all operating software for the award-winning Mark Levinson No. 32 Reference Preamplifier and Mark Levinson No. 383 Integrated Amplifier, including four dissimilar executables running on five processors of four different types.

Devised flexible user interfaces with multi-function keys, quad encoders, IR receivers and on-screen video displays.

Researched and proposed methods to improve the software development process, including code conventions, modular design, metrics, quantitative effort estimation, configuration control, software re-use and exploitation of open source repositories.

positions.title: Principal software engineer
positions.description:
Designed firmware in assembly language for an 8032 based A/V controller, including infrared communications, LC display, serial port, keypad, battery-backed RAM and DTMF telephone interface. 

Designed firmware for a Microchip “PIC” 16C55 based infrared receiver module, including PC hardware and software to program “trainable” remote controls with custom infrared codes.

Designed, built and tested hardware enhancements to existing systems, and produced user’s manuals detailing the expanded capabilities. Solely responsible for version control, problem tracking, and release of software to manufacturing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and maintained firmware running on Intel 80x86 processors, in an asymmetrically multiprocessing (80186/80188/i860) real-time Digital Video Effects system. Implemented software routines used to service custom image manipulation and serial communication hardware according to engineers' specifications.

Assisted in system integration efforts by serving as a liaison between software and hardware designers, improved effectiveness of diagnostic software used by technicians for production test, and automated the generation of a wide variety of software configurations using UNIX Make, AWK and utilities written in "C."

positions.title: Production Electronic Test/Engineering Technician
positions.description:
Performed electronic test, component level troubleshooting, calibration and alignment of commercial television broadcasting equipment. The devices, which included time base correctors, frame synchronizers and Digital Video Effects (DVE) systems, incorporated high speed A/D and D/A converters, microprocessor controls, high speed memory architectures and sophisticated mixed-signal PLLs and video processing circuitry.

Fabricated complex wire-wrapped prototypes for engineering directly from schematics, including some designs incorporating nearly a hundred MSI/LSI devices.
